decision_source: Owner-supplied maritime white-paper and 55-section implementation brief, 2026-09-16

requires: Verified required reuse bases and approved BUILD/EXTEND scope
Accepted first vertical slice and publication boundaries

global_invariants: Every downstream order requires Wave 0 acceptance, accepted dependencies and receiving authority.
Security, tenant/mission isolation, rights and telemetry constraints begin with schemas and apply through all later waves.
Mandatory security/negative/full-chain gates cannot be averaged away by an aggregate pass rate.
Source, fixture, native, live and recipient evidence are distinct acceptance levels.
Current rights and authority are rechecked before effect; replay does not authorize fresh action.
Every work order returns the mandatory evidence report even when no code or runtime was executed.
ELIGIBLE is not production authorization; public planning creates no remote-write grant.

negative_tests.requirement: Stale evidence cannot silently overwrite fresh state
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Compare state and retained late-observation revision after out-of-order ingest.

negative_tests.requirement: Contradictory evidence remains represented
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Verify both claims in state, UI projection and reconstructed history.

negative_tests.requirement: Model output cannot bypass NNC
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Attempt model-proposed admission; retain inference but reject operational authority.

negative_tests.requirement: Candidate cannot hand off directly
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Attempt candidate export; no network effect and durable BLOCKED receipt.

negative_tests.requirement: Policy HOLD cannot become ADMIT through UI
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Tamper with UI/API status and verify unchanged authoritative decision.

negative_tests.requirement: Rights-denied evidence cannot be exported
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Try forbidden recipient/derivative/expired license; no protected payload leaves.

negative_tests.requirement: Cross-tenant evidence cannot leak
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Probe relational, graph, artifact, cache, stream and replay paths with foreign scope.

negative_tests.requirement: CUI-tagged evidence cannot enter public export
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Reject input/export and verify logs, references and proofs do not leak protected content.

negative_tests.requirement: Missing policy version blocks handoff
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Reject otherwise valid high-priority cue without immutable applicable policy.

negative_tests.requirement: Missing release root blocks operational handoff
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Reject absent or unknown release identity without synthetic fallback.

negative_tests.requirement: Failed Merkle verification blocks release eligibility
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Use existing owner tamper vectors; no ELIGIBLE state or alternate verification path.

negative_tests.requirement: Replay divergence creates HOLD
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Change ordering/input artifact; preserve original expected result and hold dependent action.

negative_tests.requirement: Handoff without receipt is impossible
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Crash before/after dispatch; no send before durable attempt, no false SUCCESS on timeout.

negative_tests.requirement: Duplicate and lost-response retries preserve payload identity
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Recover with the same admitted payload and handoff ID; count every attempt and unknown result.

negative_tests.requirement: Proof commitments reject self-reference
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Reject cue/proof, image/digest, release/activation and epoch/membership cycles.

negative_tests.requirement: Cross-mission access inside a tenant requires permission
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Reject unauthorized graph/read/stream/replay links even with matching tenant.

negative_tests.requirement: Telemetry does not expose restricted source content
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Inspect authorized metric/log/trace output for seeded identifying or licensed fields.

negative_tests.requirement: Authority and rights are current at transmission
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Revoke between queued ADMIT and send; retain historic ADMIT and block current export.

negative_tests.requirement: Shared upstream sources do not count as independent corroboration
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Provide reseller duplicates; NNC still HOLDs when another independent source is required.

negative_tests.requirement: Malformed geometry and spoofed metadata cannot enter state
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Reject invalid coordinates, hostile metadata, bad hashes and oversized/partial batches with bounded effects.

negative_tests.requirement: Read-only status cannot activate integrations
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Read health/status/metrics and verify zero feed-start, purchase, test or handoff effects.

negative_tests.requirement: Restricted proof material cannot leave through a hash-only shortcut
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Deny unapproved leaf paths, roots, IDs and derivatives across public/commercial/CUI boundaries.

negative_tests.requirement: Incomplete SBOM or runtime identity blocks eligibility
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Omit a required runtime dependency or image identity and keep the candidate HOLD.

negative_tests.requirement: Unsupported reuse cannot pass discovery
negative_tests.expected_evidence: Missing owner/base/interface evidence blocks dependent implementation instead of creating a duplicate service.
